tei:div.tei:p: 293) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rtsa gsum spyi'i dbang bzhi rgyal thabs spyi blugs mdzes pa'i do shal don dbang 'brel tshad don ldan mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud zab pa'i snying po bzhugs so: 294)na mo padma kā ra ye:

rtsa gsum lha la gus pas 'dud: ma 'ongs padma'i rjes 'jug don: zab chos sna tshogs gter du sbas: gter rigs mi 'dra bsam mi khyab: rang rang las skal ldan pa yi: zab mo'i chos gter sna tshogs kyis: skal ldan las can smin par mdzad: 'gro ba'i mun sel gsang sngags kyi: bstan pa'i gzhi tshugs chos char 'bebs: gang 'brel padma 'od du 'dren: sa ma ya: chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: chos skor rtsa gsum gang rung gi: cho ga gang la sbyar du rung: dbang bzhi rgyal thabs spyi blugs 'di: phyi rabs skal ldan nyams su longs: sa ma ya: de yang spros bcas rim pa ni: dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas dang ni: sgrub khang la sogs gang dag rung: dkyil 'khor legs bkod rtsa gsum gyi: gtor ma bum pa bhan thod dang: thugs srog sku tsaka rig ma sogs: bshams nas rtsa gsum gang yin gyi: bdag mdun las bum sgrub pa dang: dbang blang dbang ldan rgyal po rje'i: chas gsol slob ma mdun du 'khod: grus byas bgegs bskrad srung ngor bsgom: lo rgyus 'chad cing mos gus bskyed: gsol ba gdab pa 'di skad do: e ma: gsang sngags bla med drod 'chang ba: dbang ldan rgyal po bla ma rje: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: gsang ba'i lam mchog thob pa'i 295)phyir: smin byed dbang bzhi'i gnang ba stsol: zhes lan gsum brjod nas bla mas 'di skad bskul: hoḥ bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: las dang skal bar ldan pa rnams: smin byed dbang gi gdams pa sbyin: theg dman blo chung dam log kun: snod dang mi ldan phyir dengs shig: gsang ba zab mo'i gdams pa 'di: u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin: brgya lam la yang 'byung mi srid: de bzhin gsang sngags bla med chos: snod ldan bu la bdag gis bstsal: dga' spro dad gus chen po yis: gsang sngags ji bzhin bslab par gyis: zhes brjod: de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag bdun pa rnams gab thig ltar ro:

me tog mig ras 'bul ba ni: hoḥ khyed rang rnams kyis sngon chad kyi yi dam gang yin pa de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la phyag stong du mjal mi rung zhing phyag rten gyis slad du me tog gi phreng ba re 'dzin pa'i mos pa mdzod: ces dang: a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐: tsakṣu bhandha wa ra ma ṇa ye swā hā: slob ma lhar bskyed pa ni: oṃ ma hā bū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā 296)wa atma ko3haṃḥ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis slob ma rnams cham mer gsal ba'i gnas gsum dang 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas sku gsum dag pa'i zhing rab 'byams nas ye shes pa dpag tu med pa kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du spyan drangs nas bskyed pa'i dam tshig sems dpa' rnams la mtsho la kha ba babs pa bzhin du sib sib thim par bsgom: spyan 'dren ni: spos rol dbyangs bcas 'di skad do: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang bzhin chos dbyings rnam dag pho brang nas: stong gsal ma 'gags che ge mo'i lha: gtso dang 'khor 'das gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: skal ldan slob ma'i sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs: nyams rtogs ye shes yon tan mngon du gyur: don gnyis mthar phyin sku gnyis zung 'jug cing: thun mong grub brgyad mchog tu rig 'dzin bzhi: da ltar nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol: rtsa sngags mthar: badzra sa ma ya a we sha ya pheṃ pheṃ hring hring dza dza: ye shes dbab pa de nyid slob ma'i sgo gsum la brtan par gyur cig: tiṣṭha badzra: me tog 'bul pa ni: kye hoḥ rig pa'i me tog 297) dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: sngon chad yi dam lha mchog gang yin pa: de la babs pas ma brjed yid la zungs: lha de'i dngos grub thob cing gsang mtshan 'dzin: oṃ badzra puṣpe siddhi trāṃ: zhes brjod me tog 'bul zhing mig ras bsal ba ni: kye hoḥ sngon chad ma rig sgrib dbang gis:

rig pa ye shes ngo ma mjal: da ni bla ma'i thugs rje yis: ma rig sgrib pa bsal bar bya: oṃ badzra tsakṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa: de nas dkyil 'khor lha ngo bstan pa ni: e ma: skal ldan bu rnams kun: gsang sngags bla med dkyil 'khor 'dir: mthong ba tsam gyis las sgrib dag: ma bsgom sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i thabs: rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mchog: thob nas rnam mkhyen sa ru 'god: oṃ dzñā na bhrūm̐ maṇḍa la hūm̐: de nas dngos gzhi'i dbang zhu ba'i phyir maṇḍal phul la: gsol ba gdab pa 'di skad do: e ma: thar pa'i lam ston bla ma rje: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: yi dam che ge mo'i dngos gzhi'i dbang: yongs rdzogs dam pa bstsal du gsol: zhes lan gsum brjod: 'di skad bskul: kye hoḥ rigs can skyes bu gang su dag: gsang sngags dkyil 'khor chen 298)po 'dir: dam tshig ma nyams bsrung nus sam: bskyed rdzogs gzhung bzhin bsgrub nus sam: bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrub nus sam: gsang sngags gnad dang ldan nus sam: bla med gsang ba'i dbang mchog 'di: gang la bskur du mi rung zhing: gsang zhing gsang ba don gyi gnad: u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin: 'di dang 'phrad pa skal bar ldan: spro ba bskyed la dam tshig gi srungs: badzra sa ma ya na ra kan: sa ma ya: de nas bum pa thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag spros bral chos sku'i bum pa ru: yi dam cha ma'i dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub: bsam brjod bral ba'i bdud rts-i'i chu yis bkang: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: sku mchog 'gyur med mchog gi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bhan thod sogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang byung mtshan ldan bhandha'i nang: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gsung gi bcud: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsung gsang mi zad dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: thugs srog sa bon thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings rnam dag 'od lnga'i thig le'i klong:

spros bral 'gyur med rdo rje'i thugs 299)srog hrīḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: thugs mchog 'khrul bral mchog gi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bde stong ḍā ki'i sku thogs la: gsol ba btab pa 'di skad do: kye: rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: dus gsum rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rje: gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje yis: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: shes rab zab mo'i ye shes dbang: lam mchog dam pa stsal du gsol: zhes dang: rdo rje'i bla mas 'di skad bskul: e ma: skal ldan rigs bzang rnams: gsang sngags bla med dkyil 'khor du: thabs mang dka' ba med pa yi: shes rab zab mo la brten nas: theg pa mchog gi lam bzang la: 'jug par spro ba gang su dag: bud med mi spang dang du blangs: rim gnyis lam mchog mi 'da' bsrung: badzra sa ma ya na ra kan: zhes brjod nas mi mo rigs bzang dngos su yod na mtsho rgyal gsang dbang shes rab rtsa 'byed dang ngo sprod gsang ba'i srog thig rnams bya'o/ bsdu na rig tsag thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ ye shes rol gar bde ba'i cho 'phrul las: shes rab mchog gi ye shes ston mdzad pa: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: 300)dga' bzhi ye shes mchog gi dbang thob shog: ma hā mu dra gu hya bho dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: stong bzhi'i 'od gsal ngang du rig pa skyongs: rig dbyings 'gyur med spros bral rang zhal mjal: sa ma ya: de nas shel rdo thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ dri bral dwangs gsal shel rdo rma bya'i mdongs: zang thal dri bral 'dod lnga'i rang gdangs shar: skye grol gnyis med rig pa bsam brjod bral: 'khor 'das chos kun me long gzugs ji bzhin: rang shar rang grol brda yid dbang bskur roḥ ka dag tshig gi dbang mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags dang: āḥ phaṭa: lan gsum: mnyam par bzhag cing ngo sprod ni: e ma: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams kun:

ma yengs rig pa'i ngang du skyongs: bskyang bya skyong byed yul las 'das: bsam brjod bral ba'i rig pa che: yengs 'khrul med pa kun tu bzang: gshis lugs ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang: 'gags med gsal stong kun bzang mo: gnyis med mnyam nyid 'khor 'das khyab: kun shes kun rig zang ka ma: skye 'gags bral ba rig pa che: bu khyod ma yengs sems la ltos: bltas pas mi mthong ma bltas gsal: gsal stong 'gags med klong du 301)zhog: zhen 'dzin blo yi bcos ma gzhug: don dam blo 'das klong chen mkha': thog babs ting 'dzin chen po yi: ye grol klong du mnyam par bdag: tshe gcig don gyi sangs rgyas 'grub: the tshom med do rigs kyi bu: zhes gsal gdab: de nas rtsa gsum gang yin gyi sku tsaka thogs la 'di skad do: hūm̐ hrīḥ mtshan dpe rab rdzogs sku yi bkod pa mdzes: yon tan rang chas rdzogs pa rgyal ba'i sku: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: yon tan mi zad rgyan gyi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ḥ de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ snang ba yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du: srid pa bcud kyi ba liṃ ta: brjid ldan ro nus stong dang ldan: snang ba sna tshogs rgyan bkod legs: rtsa gsum lha tshogs sgrub pa'i rten: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dbang bzhi thob cing sku bzhi'i sa thob nas: phrin las rab 'byams 'grub pa'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags dang: ma hā ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes brjod nas: chos sku kun bzang yab yum: drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen: ston pa rdo rje sems dpa': gu ru dga' rab rdo rje: rig 'dzin shrī seng haḥ paṇa chen bi ma mi tra: o rgyan padma 'byung gnas: mkha' 'gro ye shes 302)mtsho rgyal: lo chen bai ro tsa na: mkha' 'gro shel dkar rdo rje: kun bzang su kha siddhi: rtsa gsum dam can srung ma: ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro: sku'i ḍā ki: gsung gi ḍā ki:

thugs kyi= yon tan gyi= phrin las kyi= gnas yul zhing skyong gi ḍā ki dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol: sgrib bzhi dag nas sku bzhi'i dbang dang dngos grub thams cad thob par mdzad du gsol: nyon shes kyi sgrib pa dag nas rang byung ye shes rtogs par mdzad du gsol: mdor na tshe rabs kun tu che ge mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis zhal gzigs lung bstan dbugs dbyung nas bstan 'gro'i don thogs pa med par 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: khākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ zhes brjod me tog 'thor nas bka' drin gso: dge bsngo bya: bkra shis brjod nas gtang rag phul: las rjes mi mngon gsang bar bya: de yis rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma: rgyal dbang padma thod phreng gis: ma 'ongs 'gro ba'i don du yang: zab chos sna tshogs gter du sbas: rang rang las smon ldan pa yis: gter 303) nas bton te 'gro don mdzod: khyad par zab pa'i snying bcud 'di: dbyangs can sprul pas gter du sbos: ma 'ongs snyigs dus sum cu'i dus: 'gro rnams shes rgyud bdud kyis bsgyur: mi dge sna tshogs las la btson: chos sgrub rnams la bar chad mang: bskyed rdzogs ldan pa nyin skar tsam: padmas mngags pa'i pho nya la: log lta skur 'debs gnas su mthong: lta mug mtshon 'grus bskal pa dar: 'byung ba'i bcud nyams tshe bsod phro: bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe thung: bdud sprul smon log dam bri yis: rgyud bskul 'gro ba'i shes rgyud brlams: rang phung rang gis bsgrubs pa mang: de dus mtsho rgyal gsung gi sprul: ga ga tā re su kha ḍī paṃ dang: kun dga'i ming dang su kha badzra sogs: rim bzhin 'byung nas mkha' 'gro'i chos skor 'byed:

gsang grogs chos bdag smon lam dbang gis 'phrad: dus kyi rgud sel skye 'gro bde la 'god: bzang 'brel phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan srid zin: ngan 'brel 'khor ba mtha' can bde 'gro thob: mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs lnga bcu'i bar du bzlog: 'brel tshad mkha' spyod gnas sa 'dren par nges: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'di 'phrad shog: skal med log lta can dang 'di ma 'phrad: kha gsag g.yo sgyu can la gu hya rgya: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs kyis gnyer gyis shig: dam nyams log lta can gyi dbang po bsnubs: snod dang mi ldan rnams kyi srog rtsa chod: thub par srungs shig badzra sa ma ya: dam nyams lag tu 304) ma shor na ra kan: yongs la ma spel gsang ba'i bka' rgya dam: sa ma ya: sku gsung thugs kyi rgya yod do: : gsang rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: gnyan rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: (Dakini secret letter here) zhes gsang mdzod spyi gces don dbang 'brel tshad don ldan 'di yang yun ring nas brdas bskul kyang rang la yon tan med pa dang gzhan rkyen dbang gis snyoms las su song ba'i skabs gsang grogs sa manta dang badzra bidyā sogs kyis bka' nan cher phebs pa dang lung zin chos bdag ma ti lo ka bha dra pradzñā kirti'i ming sogs dang padma lhun grub rgya mtshos bzang ja gtsos rin chen sna tshogs maṇḍal bcas zab chos cha tshang phab dgos zhes nan cher bskul ngor bdag rang la yon tan cung zad tsam yang med pas dbang bskur chos bshad lta zhog rang mgo yang thon dka' mod/ 'on kyang zab chos e yin mi shes rung zob chos min nges pa red snyam nas sprul sku rnam gsum gyi bkas gnang ba thob tshe rang gi nyams snang sogs la ḍā ki gter srung rnams kyi brda bstan tshe blos byas spu ris ky-is ma bslad par bshus te skyon kun ldan pa lus dman mdo med 'chol mo dud 'gro lta bu'i 'du shes gsum pa kalpa bha dra tā re'am dī paṃ ming gis dag par phabs pa'i yi ge pa ni kun bzang snang mdzad kyis bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun 'og min dag pa'i zhing la spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
